row.proto: uint64_t Ne_Get_SettingU32(void *node, const char *name, uint32_t *out, uint32_t def)
row.notes: generic engine setting getter, unsigned 32-bit integers: same lock and lookup body as Ne_Get_SettingBool, converts with 0x143919770 (strtoul, 0x hex, K/M/G suffixes) and stores 4 bytes. 97 direct call sites, all integer settings; float settings use the sibling getter 0x143a43ea0. Reads Renderer.Gfx.groundCoverMaxInstances at 0x14014d448 (def 0x124f8) and Renderer.maxPVSRenderInstances at 0x1401553d1. Same entry as xanpavle F1-25-RE-Optimization RVA 0x03a43240
